description: Resolved-fire endogenous bulk smoke in the existing AQ tracer arena.

rows.name: fire_smoke
rows.long_name: bulk SFIRE smoke mass mixing ratio per dry air, not PM2.5
rows.provenance: WRF4.7.1 registry.fire:328,337-338 and module_fr_fire_atm.F:15-106. Native bulk source is fire_tracer_smoke*burnt_area_dt*FGIP; g/kg-air increments become ug/kg-dry through1e6*rho_air/rho_dry. No PM2.5 fraction is defined.
